offers.name: ASUS ProArt P16 Copilot+ PC Laptop (16" 4K OLED Touch Display / AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti / 32GB LPDDR5X RAM / 1TB SSD / Windows 11 Pro / H7606WR-DB92T-CA)

reviews.quote: Bright and accurate 4K tandem OLED, RTX 5090 with 24 GB of VRAM, very high-quality and compact aluminum case, excellent speakers, great input devices, 2x SSD slots, good CPU and system performance, 64 GB of RAM, Wi-Fi 7. Cons: RAM soldered, loud under load, PWM flickering, secondary SSD only PCIe 4.0. (NBC review of the H7606 RTX 5090/64GB config; same chassis/panel family as the 5060/5070 Ti tiers.)

Very premium and compact aluminum case, color accurate 4K OLED, excellent speakers, wonderful input devices, 2x SSD slots, fast CPU and good system performance. Cons: RAM soldered with massive surcharge for 64 GB; 4K OLED only 60 Hz. (NBC review of predecessor H7606 RTX 4070 config; chassis/display/input findings carry over to 2025 RTX 50-series tiers.)

design_philosophy: ASUS's creator-focused flagship: a thin-and-light 16-inch chassis with a factory-calibrated 4K OLED touchscreen, consumer GeForce graphics, and creator I/O (SD Express, USB4) instead of workstation pro-GPU pricing. This 5070 Ti build is the top consumer-GPU tier of the P16 line and the closest thing to its intended flagship creator config.
